QuestInfo.name: The Rising Fanatic!
QuestInfo.0: Your favorite star, Valerie, has something to say to you... Wonder if this is something about her fan club?
QuestInfo.1: Wow! If you help Valerie with her Rising Star training 30 times or more, you can be her official crazed fan! You need to work really hard!
QuestInfo.2: You are an official Valerie fanatic! The blue balloon says it all!

0.0: Hey there, #b#h0##k. I'm #bValerie#k, and I want to be the best Maple Rising Star ever! It's cool that you've joined my fan club and want to help out. If you work extra hard and help me win this thing, I'll even dub you my own personal #rcrazy fan#k. What do you think?

yes.0: In preparation for the Maple Rising Star Contest, if you can help me complete my training for singing, instruments, dancing, appearance, fame, and reputation #b30 times each#k, then I will consider you my #rcrazy fan#k.
yes.1: You can start each training type by clicking on the event star, or by talking to Gaga, Cassandra or the Maple Admin. As for your activity history with the fan club, check the #r7th Anniversary Diary#k you get from Cassandra. Okay, let's get this done!

no.0: Oh, I guess this was too soon for you... Maybe we can talk again later.

quest.0: I don't think you're quite active enough in the fan club. Maybe if you put more effort in...
